title: The new Apple Watch Series 4 isn't for everyone - but if you're looking for an Apple Watch, it's the one to get (AAPL)
text: The new Apple Watch Series 4 isn't for everyone — but if you're looking for an Apple Watch, it's the one to get (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Nov 3, 2018, 9:00 am 17 pts The Apple Watch is likely to be a hot holiday present this year. And the Apple Watch Series 4, which was released in September, is the first major redesign since the device was first released.
